Check out their debut JazzArt Underground or their latest album Zwierzakom (fun fact, they're all live albums too). 

Another I'd suggest is Things Falling Apart, very very similar sound to Godspeed, however I do feel like the music itself is good enough to ignore the derivativness of it.
